# fields

Neural fields: signals represented as functions fitted to samples, and scenes represented for novel view synthesis. An implicit neural representation is a coordinate encoding slot and a backbone slot (`neuralField`) fitted to samples of an image or a signed distance field (`fitField`, the optimiser a slot); a radiance field (NeRF) adds ray sampling, differentiable volume rendering and a fit to posed images (`fitNerf`); 3-D Gaussian splatting fits an explicit set of Gaussians to the same views through a differentiable projection and compositing (`fitSplats`, with adaptive density control). Each fit is an `Algorithm` with a typed contract and probes that render, and each has a method for sessions. The coordinate encodings and SIREN layers themselves are in `nn`.

- function `fitField`: Fit a coordinate network to samples of a signal. `src/lib/fields/fit-field.ts:288` `mdml-engine/fields`
- function `fitNerf`: Fit a NeRF to posed images for a number of steps. `src/lib/fields/fit-nerf.ts:461` `mdml-engine/fields`
- function `fitSplats`: Fit 3-D Gaussians to posed images, with adaptive density control. `src/lib/fields/fit-splats.ts:644` `mdml-engine/fields`
- function `volumeRender`: Differentiable volume rendering: composite densities and colours along rays. `src/lib/fields/volume.ts:75` `mdml-engine/fields`

- estimator `fitFieldMethod`: Fit an image or SDF with a neural field as a session. `src/lib/fields/field-method.ts:119` `mdml-engine/fields`
- estimator `fitNerfMethod`: Fit a NeRF to multi-view images as a session. `src/lib/fields/nerf-method.ts:128` `mdml-engine/fields`
- estimator `fitSplatsMethod`: Fit 3-D Gaussian splats to multi-view images as a session. `src/lib/fields/splats-method.ts:147` `mdml-engine/fields`

- structure `GaussianSet`: A set of 3-D Gaussians as a pytree of tensors. `src/lib/fields/gaussians.ts:49` `mdml-engine/fields`
- structure `nerfModel`: A NeRF model: one network, or coarse and fine networks. `src/lib/fields/nerf.ts:153` `mdml-engine/fields`

- table `fieldBackbones`: Backbones of a neural field as one slot. `src/lib/fields/tables.ts:152` `mdml-engine/fields`
- table `fieldEncodings`: Coordinate encodings as one slot: positional, Fourier features, hash grid. `src/lib/fields/tables.ts:57` `mdml-engine/fields`

- module `neuralField`: A coordinate encoding plus backbone as one network. `src/lib/fields/field.ts:101` `mdml-engine/fields`
